title: The Convergence of Simultaneous Arrivals

features.name: the convergence point where vectors became equals
features.desc-on-touch: All the roads that ever led here arrived at the same moment. Now they wait, side by side, in a place where arrival means you stop moving but do not stop arriving.

features.name: the parking circuit where nothing continues
features.desc-on-touch: Vehicles in their final resting places, all facing different directions they will never drive. They arrived together but from separate times. The lot is full but it is peaceful.

features.name: the weather that belongs to all of them
features.desc-on-touch: Dusk has waited for everything to arrive before it falls. The light that drifts here does not advance—it just redistributes among the arrivals, like a conversation with no one moving.

features.name: the archive's own arrival marker
features.desc-on-touch: A broadcast receiver, still humming, still recording the moment when all the separate routes collapsed into one geography. It marks the time when everything arrived at once.

features.name: the maps that disagree on what arrived first
features.desc-on-touch: Old route markers, each claiming a different moment for arrival. But they all point to here. The corruption has made them concurrent, and now they argue together in the same location.

inscription: all journeys end here, and they end together, in the moment before the next journey begins but after every arrival has learned to be simultaneous
